name: unclecode-workspace
description: UncleCode repo-local coding shell with package boundaries and a unified CLI entrypoint.

scripts.qa:runtime: npm run build --silent && cargo build --quiet -p unclecode && node scripts/unclecode-runtime-qa.mjs
scripts.qa:live: npm run build --silent && cargo build --quiet -p unclecode && node scripts/unclecode-live-provider-qa.mjs
scripts.qa:live:record: npm run build --silent && cargo build --quiet -p unclecode && node scripts/unclecode-live-provider-qa.mjs --allow-blocked
scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist-work', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.work.json
scripts.test:orchestrator: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --conditions=source --import tsx --test tests/orchestrator/*.test.mjs tests/orchestrator/mini-loop/*.test.mjs tests/orchestrator/hooks/*.test.mjs tests/orchestrator/aci/*.test.mjs tests/orchestrator/agentless/*.test.mjs tests/orchestrator/team-adapters/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:context-broker && npm run test:agentops-db && npm run test:session-store && npm run test:memory-bus && npm run test:snapshot-store && npm run test:plugin-host && npm run test:lsp-bridge && npm run test:server && npm run test:providers && npm run test:contracts && npm run test:runtime-broker && npm run test:orchestrator && npm run test:tui && npm run test:cli && npm run test:commands && npm run test:work
scripts.test:all: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run provenance:check && npm run node:check && npm run rust:check && npm run test && npm run rust:test
